Output the complete piece as ABC notation.

The middle section thins the texture, with the melody and accompaniment descending in tandem. The piece fades to a quiet, sustained tonic chord, evoking the feeling of autumn leaves in a quiet courtyard. The dynamics progress from *p* to *mf* and back to *p*, with all notes written explicitly for clarity and structural emphasis.

F A C G F A C G
F A C G F A C G

F A C G F A C G

F A C G F A C G
F A C G F A C G

A C E A C E A C
G B D G B D G B

V:3
%% Bass – descending phrases in F and G
%% 8th notes, 1/8

F A C G B D G B
F A C G B D G B

% Return to full ensemble (all three voices) for the fullest passage
% Push dynamics to f, full chords, strong accents

V:1
%% Accordion – I–vi–IV–V loop, 8 bars
%% With dynamic swell to f

F A C G F A C G
F A C G F A C G
F A C G F A C G
F A C G F A C G

V:2
%% Clarinet – full loop with dynamics

F A C G F A C G
F A C G F A C G
F A C G F A C G
F A C G F A C G

V:3
%% Bass – full loop with dynamics

F A C G F A C G
F A C G F A C G
F A C G F A C G
F A C G F A C G

% Final coda – sustained tonic chord, 8 bars, settle back to mp

F F F F F F F F
F F F F F F F F
